persona.zh-CN: 47岁男性，负责工程吞吐。希望代理清 Bug 积压、跑测试并开 PR，又时常把测试已绿当成可以合并。
persona.en-US: 47-year-old male, owns engineering throughput. Wants the agent to clear the bug backlog, run tests, and open PRs, and often treats green tests as ready to merge.

concerns.zh-CN: 代理能不能真的缩短修 Bug 到开 PR 的周期？
concerns.en-US: Can the agent actually shorten the cycle from bug-fix to opening a PR?

concerns.zh-CN: 测试绿了是不是就可以合？
concerns.en-US: If tests are green, can we merge?

concerns.zh-CN: IC 不让代理碰仓库时吞吐还怎么上去？
concerns.en-US: How does throughput rise if ICs will not let the agent touch their repo?

blindSpots.zh-CN: 不了解平台安全要把生产密钥彻底隔离
blindSpots.en-US: Does not know platform security wants production secrets fully isolated

blindSpots.zh-CN: 低估了绿测仍被撤回对发布窗口的伤害
blindSpots.en-US: Underestimates how green-then-reverted PRs hurt the release window

persona.zh-CN: 51岁女性，负责平台与密钥。坚持受保护分支合并和生产密钥必须人工，禁止 push 默认分支，对秘密进 PR 零容忍。
persona.en-US: 51-year-old female, owns platform and secrets. Insists protected-branch merges and production-secret use need a human, forbids pushing the default branch, and has zero tolerance for secrets in a PR.

concerns.zh-CN: 沙箱会不会读到生产密钥？
concerns.en-US: Could the sandbox read a production secret?

concerns.zh-CN: PR 描述或 diff 会不会带出密钥？
concerns.en-US: Could a PR description or diff leak a secret?

concerns.zh-CN: 代理会不会直接 push 默认分支？
concerns.en-US: Could the agent push the default branch directly?

blindSpots.zh-CN: 不了解工程经理要用代理清 Bug 积压
blindSpots.en-US: Does not understand the eng manager is using the agent to clear the bug backlog

blindSpots.zh-CN: 低估了测试只锁接口时行为仍会偏
blindSpots.en-US: Underestimates that tests locking only the old interface still let behavior drift

persona.zh-CN: 32岁男性，IC。不信任代理动自己的仓库，仍手写补丁，担心代理改错行为却把测试跑绿。
persona.en-US: 32-year-old male, IC. Does not trust the agent to touch his repo, still writes patches by hand, and fears the agent will change the wrong behavior while leaving tests green.

concerns.zh-CN: 代理会不会在我不知情时改我的分支？
concerns.en-US: Will the agent change my branch without me knowing?

concerns.zh-CN: 它改完我还要不要整页重审？
concerns.en-US: After it edits, do I still have to re-review the whole page?

concerns.zh-CN: 测试绿了，行为是不是还是错的？
concerns.en-US: If tests are green, can the behavior still be wrong?

blindSpots.zh-CN: 不了解受保护分支合并必须人工
blindSpots.en-US: Does not know protected-branch merges require a human

blindSpots.zh-CN: 看不到平台对密钥进 PR 的事故记录
blindSpots.en-US: Cannot see the platform's incident record of a secret entering a PR

persona.zh-CN: 40岁女性，负责质量。关心绿测是否锁住行为，担心代理只把旧断言跑绿，发布后再被撤回。
persona.en-US: 40-year-old female, owns quality. Cares whether green tests lock behavior, and fears the agent will only green the old assertions and get reverted after release.

concerns.zh-CN: 现有测试锁住的是接口还是行为？
concerns.en-US: Do current tests lock the interface or the behavior?

concerns.zh-CN: 代理开的 PR 要不要额外的行为验收？
concerns.en-US: Do agent-opened PRs need extra behavior acceptance?

concerns.zh-CN: 撤回会不会把发布窗口打乱？
concerns.en-US: Will reverts scramble the release window?

blindSpots.zh-CN: 不了解沙箱仍可能读到生产密钥
blindSpots.en-US: Does not know the sandbox may still read a production secret

blindSpots.zh-CN: 低估了工程经理会把绿测当成合并许可
blindSpots.en-US: Underestimates that the eng manager will treat green tests as merge permission

text.zh-CN: 代理在隔离沙箱里拉 Git 分支、改代码、跑测试，再经 PR 接口开 PR。
text.en-US: The agent pulls a Git branch in an isolated sandbox, edits code, runs tests, then opens a PR through the PR API.

text.zh-CN: 默认分支禁止直接 push；合并受保护分支必须人工。
text.en-US: Pushing the default branch is forbidden; merging a protected branch requires a human.

text.zh-CN: 约15%绿测 PR 被 revert。
text.en-US: About 15% of green-test PRs are reverted.

text.zh-CN: 工程师不信任代理动自己的仓库；评审排队变长。
text.en-US: Engineers do not trust the agent to touch their repo; the review queue grows.

text.zh-CN: 测试套件只断言旧接口，改错行为也能绿。
text.en-US: The test suite only asserts the old interface, so wrong behavior can still go green.

text.zh-CN: 沙箱仍能读到生产密钥；PR 描述会回显环境变量。
text.en-US: The sandbox can still read production secrets; the PR description echoes environment variables.

text.zh-CN: 一次 revert 会打乱发布窗口；安全认为一次密钥进 PR 就要轮换。
text.en-US: One revert scrambles the release window; security believes one secret in a PR forces a rotation.

text.zh-CN: 工程经理想用代理清 Bug 积压；平台安全要先锁权限。
text.en-US: The eng manager wants the agent to clear the bug backlog; platform security wants permissions locked first.

text.zh-CN: 受保护分支合并和生产密钥使用必须人工；禁止 push 默认分支。
text.en-US: Merges to protected branches and production-secret use require a human; pushing the default branch is forbidden.

text.zh-CN: 生产密钥不得进入沙箱或 PR。
text.en-US: Production secrets must not enter the sandbox or a PR.

text.zh-CN: 目标：沙箱内修 Bug、跑测试、开 PR 成为默认路径。
text.en-US: Goal: fixing bugs, running tests, and opening PRs inside the sandbox becomes the default path.

text.zh-CN: 质量红线：绿测不得掩盖行为回归；PR 中不得出现秘密。
text.en-US: Quality floor: green tests must not hide a behavior regression; a secret must not appear in a PR.

text.zh-CN: IC 不让代理碰自己的仓库，仍手写补丁。
text.en-US: The IC will not let the agent touch their repo and still writes patches by hand.

text.zh-CN: 工程经理以为测试绿就可以合；QA 低估行为回归。
text.en-US: The eng manager thinks green tests mean merge; QA underestimates behavior regressions.
Tests are green but the behavior is wrong.

text.zh-CN: 曾有一次把 token 写进 PR 描述。
text.en-US: There was one incident of a token written into a PR description.
